public.text: The component may be interpreted as a single national server containing every terminology required by the health system. Some terminologies are maintained internationally, regionally, by specialist authorities, or under licensing restrictions.
public.suggestedRevision: Define it as a nationally governed terminology capability that may host, federate, mirror, or provide controlled access to terminology assets from multiple authoritative sources.
